input: Source a local tailor to alter my vintage blazer

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: The specific alterations needed (e.g. taking in the waist, shortening sleeves, re-lining) determine the skill level and specialisation required in a tailor, and affect cost and turnaround estimates.
The user's city or neighbourhood defines which tailors are actually 'local' and searchable — without this, no meaningful recommendations can be made.
A budget ceiling shapes which tailors are viable; vintage alterations can range from affordable to premium depending on the work involved.
A deadline (e.g. event date) determines urgency and whether a tailor's turnaround time is acceptable.
Knowing whether the user has any existing tailor relationships or trusted referral sources changes whether the task is a fresh search or a shortlist refinement.
The user may prioritise certain qualities — vintage fabric expertise, sustainability, walk-in convenience, or strong reviews — which filters the right tailor type.
Understanding what 'done well' looks like (booked appointment, received quotes, alteration completed) clarifies how far the plan needs to go and what the final deliverable is.

gold.taskTitle: Source a local tailor to alter vintage blazer
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to find a nearby tailor who can make alterations to their vintage blazer.

questions.title: What specific alterations does the blazer need?
questions.description: Identify the exact work required — e.g. sleeve shortening, waist suppression, shoulder adjustment, re-lining — to determine the skill level and specialisation needed in a tailor.

questions.title: What city or neighbourhood are you based in?
questions.description: Establish the user's location so that 'local' tailors can be meaningfully identified and searched.

questions.title: Do you have a maximum budget for the alterations?
questions.description: A budget ceiling helps filter tailors whose pricing is realistic for the work involved, especially given vintage garments can attract higher rates.

questions.title: Is there a deadline or event this blazer is needed for?
questions.description: A firm date determines how quickly the tailor must be able to turn the work around, ruling out those with long queues.

questions.title: Have you used or been recommended any local tailors before?
questions.description: Existing relationships or referrals can shortcut the search significantly and provide a starting point for the plan.

questions.title: What quality matters most to you in choosing a tailor?
questions.description: The user may prioritise vintage or delicate fabric expertise, eco-friendly practices, convenience, price, or review ratings — this shapes how candidates are evaluated.

questions.title: What does success look like — quotes compared, or job completed?
questions.description: Clarify whether the goal is to find and vet tailors, book an appointment, receive a quote, or see the alteration fully finished — defining the endpoint of the plan.
